name: Kurose Satori
source: She is neat and mature girl, and is the only female student who does not show any hostility toward the protagonist. Therefore, she is the protagonist's favorite student. In reality, she hates men to the extreme and is not even happy with the protagonist. She sees the protagonist in the training room and reveals HER evil intentions.
